name: caveman
summary: Agent skill that replies in terse caveman voice, cutting output tokens about 75%; six intensity levels from lite to wenyan-ultra.
description: A SKILL.md package that switches a coding agent into ultra-compressed caveman speech: articles, filler and hedging dropped while code, commands, paths, numbers and errors stay intact. Six levels (lite, full, ultra and the three wenyan variants) turn on by keyword or /caveman command, persist for the session, and switch off for security warnings, irreversible actions and ambiguous multi-step work.
contains: six levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra
persists across responses until "stop caveman" or "normal mode"
auto-disables for security warnings and irreversible actions
